hiring.positions_note: The live page lists one current file, “Resolución N°1865/2026”, but its PDF could not be read through the web reader; the number of open academic posts and whether a Medicine/Internal Medicine post is open cannot be verified today.
hiring.requires_chilean_title_note: The current 2026 notice’s requisites could not be read. An earlier ULS academic-concurso base (not evidence for the current call) says: “Si el postgrado ha sido obtenido en el extranjero y no se encontrase reconocido en Chile, éste deberá estar reconocido antes del término de su interinato.” No nationality requirement was found in the current readable notice.

international.notes: The International Relations Office supports international student and academic mobility, including external academics’ integration. No official evidence was found that Medicine is taught in English.

profile_paragraphs: ULS’s Medicine programme began its first cohort in 2026. The university reported 39 entrants in March; the SIES total supplied for this task is 38, so the figures should not be treated as interchangeable.

Medicine is attached to the Vicerrectoría Académica, not a separate Faculty of Medicine. ULS identifies Dr Natasha Kunakov as Director of the Department of Medicine and Dr Roberto Alfaro as Director of the School of Medicine.
The Hospital de La Serena, including its CDT, is part of the programme’s clinical-training pathway. ULS states that students will undertake part of their future clinical training there.

For a rheumatologist, the affiliated hospital’s CDT lists adult rheumatology procedures. The public evidence located does not establish a ULS rheumatology specialty/residency programme; clinical practice would also require Chilean recognition and immigration steps outside ULS hiring.
